content.short: Vaultody is a secure, user-friendly MPC solutions provider for institutional asset management.
content.description: Vaultody uses advanced technology to help financial institutions manage digital assets securely. It employs MPC technology and hardware enclaves (TEEs), offering multi-layer protection and real-time notifications. Features include customizable multi-layer approvals, tailored mobile applications, and comprehensive wallet management, making it an essential tool for secure asset handling.
content.meta: Vaultody offers secure MPC-based custody for institutional asset management. Discover Vaultody and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
